name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row or a column of slides that scrolls and snaps, built from CSS alone.
use: A few items of the same kind that a reader moves through one at a time or a few at a time: projects, team members, screenshots. It never moves by itself. Put it in a carousel-view with buttons and dots of the page's own, driven by the carousel behavior, when the page or a framework needs to know or set the slide in view.

instead.when: The row moves by itself and a reader loses nothing by missing an item
The region scrolls freely and nothing in it snaps

keyboard.action: Scroll the focused track, as any scroll container does; ArrowUp and ArrowDown scroll a vertical one
Moves to the track, and to the previous and next buttons and the dots, generated by the browser or the page's own in a carousel-view
Activates a button or a dot

platform.fallback: No buttons and no dots: the carousel is a row that swipes, scrolls and snaps, with a thin scrollbar as the way across. A carousel-view has buttons and dots of its own and does not depend on them
The behavior waits for the scroll events to pause before it names the current slide
Going to a slide may also scroll the page to bring the carousel into view

classes.name: carousel
classes.description: The scrolling, snapping track. Give it role="region", a label and tabindex="0" so the arrow keys can scroll it

classes.name: carousel-slide
classes.description: A slide: it snaps to the start of the track, or to its middle in carousel-center, and takes --carousel-slide of its width

classes.name: carousel-center
classes.description: The slide in view stands in the middle with its neighbors' edges on either side; the first and the last reach the middle too. Slides take 80% of the track unless --carousel-slide says otherwise

classes.name: carousel-vertical
classes.description: A column --carousel-viewport tall that scrolls and snaps up and down; slides take --carousel-slide of its height, the buttons stand at its top and bottom and the dots beside its end

classes.name: carousel-view
classes.description: Holds a carousel with previous and next buttons and dots of the page's own, which the carousel behavior drives; the generated controls step aside inside it

classes.name: carousel-previous
classes.description: Goes to the slide before the current one; stands over the track's start edge, or its top in a vertical view. Disabled at the first slide

classes.name: carousel-next
classes.description: Goes to the slide after the current one; stands over the track's end edge, or its bottom in a vertical view. Disabled at the last slide

classes.name: carousel-dots
classes.description: The row of dots under the track, or the column beside a vertical one

classes.name: carousel-dot
classes.description: Goes to the slide named in its aria-controls; its accessible name says which slide of how many

states.name: in view
states.description: On the slide's ::scroll-marker: the dot of the slide in view lengthens and takes ink

states.name: current
states.description: The dot of the current slide lengthens and takes ink

states.name: at the start
states.description: There is no slide before: the button fades out of the way

states.name: at the end
states.description: There is no slide after: the button fades out of the way

properties.name: --carousel-slide
properties.description: Width of a slide, 80% in carousel-center; set any width for a slide that peeks

properties.name: --carousel-viewport
properties.description: The height of a vertical carousel

properties.name: --carousel-control
properties.description: Size of the previous and next buttons the browser draws

properties.name: --carousel-previous-label
properties.description: The name of the previous button the browser draws, as a quoted string: 'Previous slide' unless it is set. Set it on the carousel or an ancestor in the page's language

properties.name: --carousel-next-label
properties.description: The name of the next button the browser draws, as a quoted string: 'Next slide' unless it is set
